name: Switzerland Livestock MCP
description: Provides access to Swiss livestock regulations and compliance data covering animal welfare standards (TSchV), RAUS/BTS direct payment programs, and TVD movement rules. Enables querying of housing specifications, stocking densities, feed requirements, and breed data for cattle, pigs, poultry, sheep, goats, and horses.
